records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net sales were $1.7 billion, a decrease of 16.9% over the $2.0 billion in 2022;

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our net sales decreased approximately $338.8 million, or 16.9%, for the twelve months ended December 31, 2023, compared to the prior year, due to widespread decreased demand for our semiconductor products.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Fiscal year 2023 proved to be challenging as the consumer, computing and communications markets experienced an extended slowdown, coupled with an inventory rebalancing in the industrial market in late 2023 as well as softness in certain areas of the automotive market.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Gross profit margin declined 170 basis points to 39.6% compared to 41.3% in 2022;

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income decreased 38.6% to $250.6 million, or 15.1% of revenue, compared to $408.2 million, or 20.4% of revenue, in 2022;
